limits: Original procedural demonstration, not recorded human motion. Tempo choices illustrate variants; no individual loading prescription. Physical phone and production unverified.

pause-deadlift.criteria: Floor start, pause during ascent below knee, long arms, neutral trunk, controlled return.
pause-deadlift.timing: 1.6s initial pull, 1.6s pause, 1.6s finish, .4s top, 2.4s descent, .4s bottom

tempo-deadlift.criteria: Floor start, coordinated hip and knee extension, long arms and controlled lowering; tempo is intentionally slowed.

eccentric-deadlift.criteria: Floor start, coordinated hip and knee extension, long arms and controlled lowering; tempo is intentionally slowed.
